limitations: Small exploratory experiment; no optimal setting or cross-patient EZ claim.
Benchmark is 32 channels/four estimators, not the full retained185 workload.
Directed factorization remains under review and is not used to choose smoothing here.
No production code, default settings, patient data, or regression goldens are changed.

synthetic.interpretation: SD is across independent synthetic recording means, not windows. Narrowband population MSC is (16/17)^2 inside 9-11 Hz, zero outside; band-grid endpoints differ between durations. Intermittent pair has 10% coupling duty cycle. Phase lag of shared activity does not establish physical causality.

eeg.selection: One middle contact-count record per uncommon native rate; minimum/middle/maximum contact count at 2048 Hz. Twelve random retained contacts per patient, chosen without accessing EZ targets. Full available recording, all complete windows.
eeg.preprocessing: Example workflow assumptions: native 60-Hz harmonic notches, polyphase to 2048 Hz, 0.5-500 Hz FIR, CAR across all retained electrodes; linear detrend/z-score per window. User's historical preprocessing not confirmed. This is not an EZ discrimination test.
